notes: Step 3 of E2 is worded for name binding (remaps, namespaces, topic/parameter names, device paths); the resolving change here is a middleware transport/profile file selected through an environment variable (FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE) in the user's shell, i.e. deployment configuration rather than name binding. I use `deployment_wiring` because the minimal resolving change is purely at deployment and no unit's declared or referenced interface changed; the source never states what the profile contained or which mechanism caused the delay (the profile's content is not quoted in the issue). If deployment_wiring is read strictly as name binding, the alternative stop is step 2 (`internal`): the delay is in the listener process's own middleware receive path and would occur with any correct /tf publisher. The reporter's earlier per-RMW comparison (Fast DDS timeouts vs. Cyclone DDS/GurumDDS/Connext behaviour) is withdrawn by the reporter ("I didn't re-rerun the test on all other DDS, maybe that config also affected their results"). Environment: Ubuntu 22.04, Humble binaries with tf2_ros rebuilt from tag 0.25.8 only to add logs.
